title: Piperlongumine, a piper alkaloid, enhances the efficacy of doxorubicin in breast cancer: involvement of glucose import, ROS, NF-kappaB and lncRNAs.
authors: Awasthee, Nikee; Shekher, Anusmita; Rai, Vipin; Verma, Sumit S; Mishra, Shruti; Dhasmana, Anupam; Gupta, Subash C
journal: Apoptosis : an international journal on programmed cell death
one_liner_zh: 该文研究胡椒碱增强阿霉素抗乳腺癌疗效，涉及NF-kB和lncRNA调控，仅含分子对接初步分析，非TF-DNA互作核心，方法深度不足。
abstract: Piperlongumine (PL, piplartine) is an alkaloid derived from the Piper longum L. (long pepper) roots. Originally discovered in 1961, the biological activities of this molecule against some cancer types was reported during the last decade. Whether PL can synergize with doxorubicin and the underlying mechanism in breast cancer remains elusive. Herein, we report the activities of PL in numerous breast cancer cell lines. PL reduced the migration and colony formation by cancer cells. An enhancement in the sub-G1 population, reduction in the mitochondrial membrane potential, chromatin condensation, DNA laddering and suppression in the cell survival proteins was observed by the alkaloid. Further, PL induced ROS generation in breast cancer cells. While TNF-alpha induced p65 nuclear translocation, PL suppressed the translocation in cancer cells. The expression of lncRNAs such as MEG3, GAS5 and H19 were also modulated by the alkaloid. The molecular docking studies revealed that PL can interact with both p65 and p50 subunits. PL reduced the glucose import and altered the pH of the medium towards the alkaline side. PL also suppressed the expression of glucose and lactate transporter in breast cancer cells. In tumor bearing mouse model, PL was found to synergize with doxorubicin and reduced the size, volume and weight of the tumor. Overall, the effects of doxorubicin in cancer cells are enhanced by PL. The modulation of glucose import, NF-kappaB activation and lncRNAs expression may have contributory role for the activities of PL in breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 哌立普宁（Piperlongumine, PL，piplartine）是一种源自荜茇（Piper longum L.，长胡椒）根部的生物碱。该分子最初于1961年被发现，其针对某些癌症类型的生物活性在过去十年中有所报道。PL是否能与多柔比星协同作用及其在乳腺癌中的潜在机制仍不明确。在此，我们报告了PL在多种乳腺癌细胞系中的活性。PL减少了癌细胞的迁移和集落形成。该生物碱还观察到亚G1期细胞群增加、线粒体膜电位降低、染色质凝缩、DNA梯状条带以及细胞存活蛋白的抑制。此外，PL诱导乳腺癌细胞中ROS的产生。虽然TNF-α诱导p65核转位，但PL抑制了癌细胞中的这种转位。lncRNAs如MEG3、GAS5和H19的表达也受到该生物碱的调节。分子对接研究表明，PL能与p65和p50亚基相互作用。PL减少了葡萄糖的摄取，并将培养基的pH值向碱性方向改变。PL还抑制了乳腺癌细胞中葡萄糖和乳酸转运蛋白的表达。在荷瘤小鼠模型中，发现PL与多柔比星协同作用，减小了肿瘤的大小、体积和重量。总体而言，PL增强了多柔比星在癌细胞中的效果。葡萄糖摄取的调节、NF-kappaB活化的抑制以及lncRNAs表达的调控可能对PL在乳腺癌中的活性有贡献作用。
